name: W.W. Grainger

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (W. W. Grainger logo.svg)

description: Grainger distributes maintenance, repair and operating (MRO) supplies (safety gear, pumps, plumbing, material handling, cleaning, tools) to more than 4.6 million businesses, institutions and government customers. It runs two models: High-Touch Solutions N.A. (Grainger-branded branches, sales reps, vendor-managed inventory and technical support for customers with complex needs, 78 percent of sales) and Endless Assortment (Zoro in the US and MonotaRO in Japan, online catalogues of millions of products shipped from distribution centres, 20 percent). Revenue is one-time product sales at a mark-up (39 percent gross margin), recurring through repeat orders and inventory-management contracts. It left the UK in Q4 2025 by selling Cromwell and closing Zoro UK.

employees.note: About 25,000 team members (22,100 full-time, 2,900 part-time or temporary); about 90 percent in North America, 10 percent in Asia.

businessLines.name: High-Touch Solutions N.A.
businessLines.how: Sells MRO products at a mark-up through Grainger branches, sales reps and eCommerce to customers with complex buying needs, plus inventory management and technical support; repeat orders from contracted accounts drive volume and price.

businessLines.name: Endless Assortment
businessLines.how: Online-only catalogue sales of millions of products to smaller customers through Zoro (US) and MonotaRO (Japan), shipped from distribution centres; transaction-by-transaction product sales with lower margin and fast growth.

businessLines.name: Other businesses
businessLines.how: Cromwell (UK industrial distributor, sold 2025-12-17) and a wholly owned captive insurance entity; not a reportable segment.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), earnings (includes costs of exiting the UK)

brands.note: High-Touch branded distribution in North America; $13,993M of sales
